text:
pat: heads up: after the midnight rollout of the new session-auth epochs we saw a short burst of websocket reconnects in eu-central. reconnect rate ~2x for ~8 minutes and a handful of tenants reported double session starts. anyone tracking?
emily: yep, noticed it on the latency board. traces show clients reconnecting and the gateway rejecting their opaque-sid with "epoch_mismatch" then immediately registering a fresh session. linked: /dashboards/streams/epoch-anom
sree: quick theory: the auth epoch rotation and the route-gen bump happened concurrently; clients holding an opaque-sid that encodes epoch=N got rejected by nodes that only accept epoch=N+1.
pat: log snippet: ```text
2026-06-07T00:05:12Z WARN auth reject sid=opq:eu:421 cause=epoch_mismatch
2026-06-07T00:05:12Z INFO session new sid=opq:eu:999 client=52.14.23.8 billing_flag=new_open
```
emily: that billing_flag=new_open is the problem - users were charged as if reconnect was a new session. we need a quick rollback or a grace acceptance window.
sree: mitigation in place: extended epoch-acceptance to allow previous epoch for 45s and toggled the canary to 0% while we evaluate. ops-bot fired an alert and we muted the noisy alarms.
deploy-bot: rollout paused: auth-epoch-service v7 -> 2026-06-07T00:06:00Z
pat: product question: should console show a prominent "auth-rotation + routing change = potential duplicate session risk" warning in the rollout flow? PMs were surprised this could hit billing.
emily: yes. propose console compute "session-restart-risk" heuristic: if auth_epoch flips && route_gen changes within same rollout window && session_ttl < 60s then risk = HIGH. show a confirm modal.
sree: infra patch idea: make opaque-sid verify against current_epoch and previous_epoch for a short grace duration, plus emit metric stream.auth.accepted_previous_epoch. that preserves strictness long-term but avoids race-induced charges.
pat: add trace annotation when previous_epoch accepted so post-incident reconciliation can show why we allowed it.
emily: also add streaming metric stream.auth.epoch_reject_rate so console can surface it during canaries and auto-pause if >0.2%. ticket SRE-5000.
sree: long-term: don't tie billing events to naive "session open" events when session_id looks like a resume candidate. add an explicit resume vs new_session indicator in billing pipeline so we can dedupe in reconciliation.
pat: pinging billing-bot for provisional credits for affected tenants. @billing-bot
billing-bot: BILL-422 opened: provisional credit pool allocated pending manual review.
emily: followups: INFRA-901 (accept-prev-epoch + metric), CONSOLE-789 (risk heuristic + modal), BILL-422 (billing reconciliation). I'll stub RFCs.
sree: small instrumentation ask: emit counter stream.auth.accepted_prev_epoch and a histogram for time_since_epoch_rotation when accepted. we can set alerts on the histogram tail.
pat: agreed. I'll collect the timeline and put together a one-page postmortem with the trigger, mitigation, and action items. paste short facts here and i will assemble. :memo:
